vb_textbox.text: You should press either the S and K key as soon as the gnomes appear on screen. This will allow you to gather more mushrooms than you would by clicking slower, even up to 9 mushrooms per basket. I think the gnome with the taller hat gives you more probability in regards to obtaining more mushrooms, but I'm not a 100% sure about that. I think the best strategy is to click as fast as you can when the gnomes appear. Place your fingers on the specific keys so that you'll have a quicker reaction time. Also click fast as soon as the basket appears in the forest. I think in this specific game speed is key.
